summary: This note describes Ghaziabad district, a largely suburban district of Uttar Pradesh state in northern India, located within the National Capital Region. The city of Ghaziabad serves as the district's administrative headquarters, and the district belongs to Meerut Division. It has grown into a major bedroom community for Delhi.
one_line: Ghaziabad district is a largely suburban district of Uttar Pradesh in the National Capital Region, serving as a bedroom community for Delhi.
key_facts: Ghaziabad district is a largely suburban district of Uttar Pradesh state in northern India.
Ghaziabad district is part of the National Capital Region.
The city of Ghaziabad is the administrative headquarters of Ghaziabad district.
Ghaziabad district is part of Meerut Division.
Ghaziabad district has become a major bedroom community for Delhi.
The note gives the pronunciation of Ghaziabad district as [ɣaːziːaːˈbaːd̪ ˈzɪlaː].
